verdict.rationale: Cline can run and react to live terminal processes (dev servers, tests, deploys) in real time and can browse the web/analyze screenshots to spot issues (e.g., 'fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png'), suggesting some live-app debugging capability. However there is no evidence of deeper live debugging features like console/log inspection, breakpoints, or DOM/network introspection of a running app beyond screenshot-based fixes and terminal output monitoring. Missing for 10: dedicated browser devtools integration (console errors, network requests, DOM inspection), breakpoint/step debugging support, and independent hands-on confirmation of live web-app debugging workflows.
